market_name: Will 12 or more Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether front-end (2Y) yields and fed funds futures (SOFR/SR3) are moving down in tandem; if TLT rises without rate futures confirming, treat as noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move to broad risk sentiment (SPY, VIX) to see if this is a growth-scare bid or idiosyncratic.
time_plan.2h: Look for any Fed speak, macro data, or headline that could explain a genuine repricing; verify the prediction-market move wasn't a low-liquidity blip.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether rate-cut pricing has persisted in futures curve; fade if it has reversed.
time_plan.12h: Close-of-window: confirm whether TLT held direction and whether any public catalyst (data/geopolitical) materialized that the market may have front-run.

predictions.reasoning: A market on 12+ Fed cuts in 2026 (≈300bps of easing) is an extreme tail event that only prices meaningfully if investors expect a recession or crisis forcing aggressive/emergency easing. A sharp rise in that implied probability would coincide with a rally in long-duration Treasuries as front-end and belly yields collapse on rate-cut expectations. TLT is the most liquid, direct proxy for falling long-term yields.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and EURUSD alongside rate futures to confirm dovish (not risk-off) interpretation.
time_plan.1h: If risk-off/safe-haven dynamics dominate, dollar may strengthen instead — reassess direction.
time_plan.2h: Monitor whether the cut-expectation repricing is US-specific vs global; USD reaction depends on relative central bank paths.
time_plan.6h: Reassess UUP against realized rate-differential moves.
time_plan.12h: Confirm net dollar direction and whether any catalyst emerged; note if thesis failed.

predictions.reasoning: Aggressive Fed easing expectations typically weigh on the dollar via lower rate differentials. A jump in the 12-cut probability implies dovish repricing, which is USD-negative. However this is a weak, second-order link and could reverse if the driver is a global risk-off shock that instead bids the dollar as a safe haven.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme tail (12+ cuts ≈300bps easing in a single year)
Such pricing historically only meaningful under recession/crisis/emergency-easing scenarios
Standard macro linkages: dovish repricing -> lower yields (TLT up), weaker USD (UUP down)
700bps tradability threshold is far above plausible 12h moves for these liquid proxies
uncertainty_notes: This is a low-probability tail market; small notional/low-liquidity moves in implied probability are unreliable signals
If the driver is a global risk-off/geopolitical shock, USD could rally (safe haven), inverting the FX call
Expected 12h magnitudes (25-40bps) are well below the 700bps tradable bar, so neither prediction is actionable under the stated rule

llm_justification.summary: A market on 12+ Fed cuts in 2026 is an extreme dovish/crisis tail. A sharp rise in its implied odds would most plausibly map to falling long-term yields (TLT up) and a softer dollar (UUP down) via rate-cut repricing. Both links are second-order and modest in magnitude over 12h, far below the 700bps tradable threshold, and could invert under a safe-haven risk-off scenario. Treat as a weak, low-confidence signal rather than a tradable edge.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects genuine dovish Fed repricing rather than noise/low liquidity
Rate-cut expectations transmit to Treasury yields and FX in the standard direction
No offsetting safe-haven flow that reverses the dollar leg
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is a low-liquidity blip with no information content
A risk-off/geopolitical shock drives both cut expectations AND a dollar rally, inverting the FX call
The dovish shift is already fully public (in futures curve), so no fresh asset move follows
12h magnitudes are tiny relative to the 700bps bar, making both predictions non-tradable
Equities could move either way (easing bullish vs recession bearish), so no clean equity mapping was made
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
